comparison.objective: Select conveyor parts and assemble a pictured model while rejecting distractors; candidate physically separates ceramic media from washers by size.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed conveyor interception, visual part selection, parking and rigid-part stacking versus bimanual load sharing and force-limited agitation of a loaded perforated screen.
comparison.success_condition: Correct four-part assembly, all extra parts conveyed away and no belt jam versus ≥98% target-media recovery, complete washer retention, no spill, supported reseating and released dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: Both select among mixed objects, but the conveyor task tests recognition and assembly, whereas the candidate tests physical aperture-based many-body separation.
